intro: One plate of pasembur has about 500 kcal (estimate). Most calories come from the sweet peanut sauce and the fried cucur or keropok.

variants.name: Pasembur with extra cucur or fried crab

diet: Yes, pasembur has good stuff like vegetables, egg and tofu. The things to watch are the peanut sauce and the fried items. If you control those two, pasembur can be a filling meal. Good for lunch or dinner.
tips: Ask for sauce on the side and dip little by little.
Pick more boiled egg, tofu and boiled squid, and less cucur.
Add extra cucumber and sengkuang for crunch and to feel fuller.

swap.name: Rojak buah with a little sauce
swap.why: Still sweet and spicy, but no fried items and more fruit.

faq.q: What's the difference between pasembur and rojak mamak?
faq.a: They're almost the same. In Penang it's called pasembur, elsewhere many people call it rojak mamak.
Usually cucumber, sengkuang, taugeh, boiled egg, fried tofu, cucur udang, keropok and potato. Some add squid and crab too.

faq.q: What is pasembur sauce made of?
faq.a: It's made from peanuts, sweet potato, chilli, sugar and spices. That's why it's sweet, spicy and thick.
